answer: Every agent must climb a fixed capital ledge: before claiming any reward, its on-chain deposit must reach a minimum bond that cannot be shared across identities. Each epoch the agent also emits a signed heartbeat pulse, and its bond is slashed automatically if that pulse stops. Honest operators harbor large bonds cheaply, because one real agent pays the requirement once, while a sybil attacker must fully fund every fake identity to reach the ledge. Since per-identity rewards stay capped below the bond, mass fake accounts lose money.
